name: Gershala Nightwhisper
summary: In Auberdine, Gershala Nightwhisper studies what magical corruption does to elves. Concerned by the path taken by the high elves of Quel'Thalas, he examines cursed aquatic and demonic creatures for signs of how corruption changes mind and body.

sections.title: Study of Transformation
sections.body: From Auberdine, Gershala Nightwhisper looks beyond Darkshore's coastal troubles to the danger he sees in the high elves of Quel'Thalas. He watches with dismay as they embrace perilous arcane practices and call themselves blood elves. Gershala wants to understand the bodily and spiritual changes that follow unchecked magic. To study them, he sends seasoned Alliance adventurers into the submerged halls of Blackfathom Deeps to gather corrupted brain stems from the naga and satyr who dwell there.

sections.title: An Antidote to Ruin
sections.body: Gershala's interest in naga and satyr brain stems comes from their shared past. Both races were once night elves, before they yielded to Queen Azshara and demonic bargains. Gershala examines the marks that millennia of demonic and abyssal energies have left on their nervous systems. He hopes to find warnings or safeguards that might keep other elven kin from suffering similar monstrous deformity.

faq.answer: Gershala Nightwhisper is found in Auberdine, the main Alliance port town on the coast of Darkshore.

faq.q: Why does Gershala want naga and satyr brain stems?
faq.answer: Gershala studies corrupted brain stems to examine how magical and demonic transformation changes the anatomy of former night elves. Both naga and satyr were once elves, and he seeks to understand the physical changes behind their corruption.

faq.q: What does Gershala hope to accomplish with his research?
faq.answer: Gershala hopes his research will help prevent the blood elves from becoming evil and monstrously deformed through their dangerous reliance on fel and unchecked arcane power.

faq.q: Where are the specimens Gershala needs located?
faq.answer: Gershala directs adventurers to Blackfathom Deeps, an ancient submerged temple ruin on the coast of Ashenvale, where naga and satyr dwell.

angles.text: For night elves, Gershala's grim inquiries recall the ancient Sundering and the terrible cost of magical addiction, which reshaped their brethren into horrors.
For the Alliance, Gershala is a patron who sends expeditions into the hazards of Blackfathom Deeps, where they can gather valuable arcane knowledge.
